overall_summary: Analysis of the recent 14 Shorts indicates that 'self respect' and boundary-setting themes (e.g., deleting chats, removing saved numbers) perform relatively better in terms of view counts (averaging 30-40 views) compared to passive overthinking or general sad quotes (which hover around 5-20 views). Action-oriented emotional moments drive higher initial engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (40 views) and 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर' (33 views) outperform passive emotional pain.
winning_patterns.action: Focus storytelling on a definitive micro-action taken to reclaim personal dignity.

winning_patterns.evidence: Hooks mentioning specific phone interfaces (pinned chats, emergency contacts, blue ticks) capture attention quickly.
winning_patterns.action: Continue using highly specific, relatable digital relationship artifacts in hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Broad hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' (12 views) or 'मेज पर रखी चाय' (5 views) resulted in lower view counts.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic late-night atmospheric openings unless tied to a specific digital or physical action.

next_video.concept: Removing someone from the 'Close Friends' or restricted list on social media as an act of silent closure rather than revenge.
next_video.opening_direction: कथा की शुरुआत इस बात से हो कि कैसे 'क्लोज फ्रेंड्स' स्टोरी सिर्फ एक शख्स के लिए डाली जाती थी।
next_video.twist_direction: और फिर अचानक उस एक शख्स को उस लिस्ट से हमेशा के लिए हटाकर, खुद के लिए जीने का फैसला कर लेना।
next_video.reason: Matches the proven high-performing self-respect and digital boundary-setting pattern.

experiment: Testing social media privacy settings ('Close Friends' list removal) as a fresh sub-theme within the winning 'self respect' category.
